title: Invariance Makes LLM Unlearning Resilient Even to Unanticipated Downstream Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical robustness of LLM unlearning methods against subsequent fine-tuning. While it mentions societal risks like bias and harmful content in the introduction and an impact statement, it does not evaluate or benchmark moral reasoning, religious values, or ethical frameworks as a core component of its research.
